--! id: netcheck
--! name: 网络诊断
--! version: 1.2

-- 网络诊断：用设备自己的 Wi-Fi/4G 直接访问漫巴士站点与图床，判断能否脱离网关独立运行
-- 只依赖 net.get（固件已有），不需要网关提供任何数据

local W = ui.size()
local TOP = ui.content_top()
local LH = ui.line_height()

local CHECKS = {
  { label = "站点首页", url = "https://manbashi.com/" },
  { label = "详情页", url = "https://manbashi.com/comic/MBS649440" },
  { label = "封面图床", url = "https://t.mbs0.top/uploads/MBS_649440_cover_87733bf0de.webp" },
  { label = "正文图床", url = "https://img1.mbs0.top/" },
}

local lines = {}       -- 每项的检测结果
local done = 0         -- 已完成项数

-- 非 2xx 时 net.get 返回 nil + "HTTP 403" 之类的错误，正好能看出是被拦还是不通
local function probe(index)
  local item = CHECKS[index]
  local body, err = net.get(item.url, 8000)
  if body then
    local head = body:sub(1, 1)
    lines[index] = "可用 " .. #body .. "B" .. (head == "<" and "（HTML）" or "")
  else
    lines[index] = err or "失败"
  end
end

-- 必须提供全局 draw()，框架进入小应用时调用
function draw()
  ui.clear()
  ui.title("网络诊断")
  local y = TOP + 8
  ui.text("用设备当前网络直连以下地址：", 16, y, W - 32)
  y = y + LH + 6
  for i = 1, #CHECKS do
    ui.text(CHECKS[i].label, 16, y, W - 32)
    ui.text(lines[i] or "检测中…", 32, y + LH, W - 48)
    y = y + LH * 2 + 6
  end
  ui.footer(done >= #CHECKS and "语音键重测 · 电源退出" or "正在检测…")
end

local function run()
  lines = {}
  done = 0
  draw()
  ui.flush(true)
  for i = 1, #CHECKS do
    probe(i)
    done = i
    draw()
    ui.flush()
  end
end

function on_key(action)
  if action == "ok" then
    run()
  elseif action == "back" then
    sys.exit()
  end
end

run()
